bio_en: Stepan Ter-Mkrtchian was born in Agulis, the home town of Kristapor Mikaelian, and after completing the seminary entered public life. He belonged to the 'old Dashnak' intelligentsia of the 1890s, whose chief concern was the fate of the Armenians under Ottoman rule. His death was announced by telegram in March 1917, at a moment when the dreams of his generation seemed close to fulfilment. His obituary, by A. Tadevosian, appeared in Horizon (Tiflis) on 29 March 1917.
